timeline.title: Reyna and Sage, Ascent
timeline.caption: A Valorant match. And we both didn't know that this would end up being the start of the most beautiful journey of our lives. I scouted my entire match history for the screenshot lmao.

timeline.title: day one
timeline.caption: We said yes to each other for the first time.

timeline.title: the plot twist
timeline.caption: You left me for your ex. Well I am glad he cheated ngl. Call me selfish but It blew up spectacularly. We laugh about it now, but at the time you left me completely broken.

timeline.title: the real start
timeline.caption: You made me a whole PDF. Custom fonts, backgrounds, screenshots, a video of you talking, voice notes, your own photos. An actual presentation. I don't think I stood a chance after that. This is the day we actually began. And you made sure it was on 5th lol. The efforts and attention to detail.

timeline.title: chocolates on Blinkit
timeline.caption: You were on your period and I sent chocolates over on a whim. Small thing, but it's the kind of small thing that matters.

timeline.title: introduced to your mum
timeline.caption: You introduced me to your mum. That's not a small thing either.

letters.heading: for what I felt in the past month
letters.body:
Dear Bhindi, 

 I mean where do I even start yaar? Throughout this entire month you kept making me feel like the luckiest guy alive on earth every single day through your small gestures. Be it your small gifts, The big sword you got me or random pics from making not gol rotis to cleaning the kitchen to spicy pics. You just have it all. And I genuinely appreciate you so much for making feel so special because no one to this day did so. 
 and ofc I too always try to make you feel as loved as possible even though I also hurt you at times but I always try to make up for it by doing stuff that you appreciate and that make you feel loved. And I will forever keep doing so. And ofc I forgot to mention the most important thing throughout all this, Happy First month anniversary baby. You are perfect and I love you so so much. Don't be insecure about yourself baby because you are literally perfect. More on that down the line tho. I'll end this one here. Mwahh

letters.heading: My product review for you as a gf
letters.body:
My Love, 

 Well if I bought you off amazon or flipkart, I'd prolly rate you like a solid 4.5 stars. And lemme actually tell you why you got the 4.5 stars before jumping to where you lost the 0.5. And yes you'll get a product review every month from now on based on how you treat me the entire month. Well for starters, You have the most beautiful voice in the world and I am like so in love with it. Honestly I can listen to it all day long and not get bored so for that you get a solid 0.5 stars. You have the prettiest face in the world even though you always try to hide it, I have your pics and trust me — You look gorgeous as you are right now. So for that you get another 0.5 stars. Then let's talk about your body, well trust me you have the most jaw dropping and gorgeous body in the world and I'd probably eat you up if we lived closeby. And like the more I compliment it the better. So for that you get another 0.5 stars and a bonus 0.5 for having the most beautiful pair of boobies in the world. Then comes your personality. You are genuinely the coolest person I've ever met and you are so interesting to know more about and you are so kind and humble and always try to make me happy. So for your personality you gain a whole 1 star. Then comes the way you treat me, Well this category had 1 star but you'll only get 0.5 stars because you always try to make me happy but you sometimes forget the fundamental thing that makes me happy that is clear communication. Since this is a product review I'll be honest with you, Ion like the way you hide things from me saying that they are not relevant. Might not be relevant for you they are for me. And you just go silent and I hate that, Silence is almost always suffocating for me due to my past experiences so I am deducting half a star here. And the remaining star you gain in efforts because as always there is nothing to complain about in this field. You genuinely do so much for me and I can never match that. Getting me gifts, pic, voice notes, You just do it all so yeah that sums up your 4.5 stars. But yes I'd really appreciate it if you wrote a review about me being completely honest like this so that I can grasp my mistakes too. Thats about it for this one.

letters.heading: This one is appreciation towards your efforts
letters.body:
Meri devi, 

 Tu sachme devi hai yaar. Yk lemme tell you something. Ye jo toy tune kaal mujhe diya for first month anniversary, tujhe pata hai this has been my fream for so long. Like everytime It comes up on my feed I open amazon and check the price and see that its like 1k - 1.5k and I back down because I don't like spending that kind of money for myself. And mujhe subah subah wo dekh ke kitni khushi huwi thi you wont understand. I was literally jumping around like a toddler getting Lollipop. And moreover I've never experienced what it feels to recieve. I've always been the person to give, maine gifts diye hai but mujhe pehli baar kisise aisa kuch mila. And mein jitna bhi bolu ki Ion want you to spend your money on me that I actually don't, It does really feel good to be on the recieving end. Because only gifts I ever got were from my parents but someone actually being thoughtful for me is something I never realised I needed. I still dont think I deserve all this but what you did for me? I really appreciate it and You will get so much more from me in the future. I love you so much baby. That's it for this one. Mwahhhh.

letters.heading: This one is about our future
letters.body:
Baby, 

 I don't see a future without you and I don't even want to imagine what it will be like for me to be having to live in a world where you are not ny my side. I genuinely imagine my entire future with you starting from celebrating this one month anniversary to celebrating our first month anniversary to marrying you, having kids and growing old with you. In the process I genuinely wanna get better for you so you never have to go looking for someone better, So that I am always the best for you. And I also want that you too please don't try to look for a better future because trust me I will do my very best to give you the best possible future. Just ofc gimme some time and I will give you the entire fucking world because trust me you deserve it. Sometimes i think that I don't deserve you but fuck it, I will be worthy of you one day and until then I'll keep working on myself so that I am worth of having you. Ending this here. Mwahh.

letters.heading: This one is about imperfections
letters.body:
Hanshni Rana, 

 This one is about to be serious. See I don't expect any of us to be perfect. No one is perfect in this world. Every person comes to this world with their own set of flaws and it's okay. Yes in my eyes you are perfect but you have some flaws too. When I say I accept you, I accept your flaws too along with your good things. Ofc your flaws are not sharing everything, your traumas, your insecurites but these are nothing that I cannot fix over the years. I just need some time with you and I will fix it all. 
 I have some fatal flaws too. The worst one being it takes me way too long to realise my mistakes. When I say something wrong and hurt you, It takes me way too long to realise my mistakes and apologize. But don't worry I will alwways apologize to you no matter how grave my sins may be. All I expect from you is tu baas thoda sa patience rakha kar. Just wait for me to realise my mistake and I will always come back begging for you to forgive me. I have other flaws too but those are just things that you can naturally notice so I am not mentioning those like over-possessiveness or getting jealous easily. All I am saying is that I need some time to heal both you and myself and I just expect that from you. With that said I will get everything on track just give me some time because I too am a kid who is trying to figure out life :). Mwahh.

finale.heading: This is the conclusion and a small developer's note.
finale.body: Okay so if you made it this far, thank you so much for reading everything. I dont know if this one was upto your expectations since its hard to match what I did previously. But anyways this text is not even a formal message anymore. This is like a note from a developer who's been working too hard for this project and its 4 am rn and I don't even know what I am saying. But yes I'll say that this entire thing even though really small compared to your efforts, you deserve it all and so much more for being the person you are. Trust me baby you are perfect. And lemme also tell you why this project may look a lil underpolished compared to my previous works. Actually I wanted to do something unique for you so this website is made on a completely different base than my normal projects. In easier words I learnt an entire new way of doing this to do it more efficiently and to be able to finish it in time. But anyways enough blabbering about myself, If this entire project made you smile even in the slightest I'd consider myself really lucky and this entire time I put into this project worth it. And about how much time I put into this? — Just ask me in real life because its not finished yet so I don't know how long it took and honestly I couldn't care less. I'll just ask you to make sure that I can do this for you every month forever and ever and ever and I just want you by my side forever no matter how hard things get. This got way too lengthy prolly so I'll end it here even though I can yap abt it so much more. Sorry if I bored you. I love you so much baby. Mwahhhhhh.
